Copy the prompt below to any AI assistant (Doubao, ChatGPT…), send your timetable screenshot, then paste the AI output back into the text field above to import.

Task: Convert the timetable screenshot I send into plain text using the format below. Output nothing else—no explanations, no Markdown code blocks, no characters outside this specification.

The output consists of four blocks in this exact order:
Block A: Single line <<<SLEEPY-BEGIN>>> (this is the first output line)
Block B: Schedule period lines (present ONLY if the screenshot shows start/end time for each period; if no schedule times are visible, omit Block B entirely—see Omitting Schedule Block rules below)
Block C: Course lines
Block D: Single line <<<SLEEPY-END>>> (this is the last output line)

Block B and Block C must not contain empty lines. Between Block A/B, B/C, and C/D, empty lines are optional (recommended: no empty lines, follow the example).

========== Block B: Schedule (Period Times) ==========

The schedule describes what time each period runs, applicable to all days Monday through Sunday. If different days have different schedules, follow the Omitting Schedule Block rules.

Schedule markers:
 <<<SLEEPY-TIME-BEGIN>>>
 (one schedule line per period)
 <<<SLEEPY-TIME-END>>>
(All three markers must appear together, or none at all. Cannot have only BEGIN without END.)

Schedule line format (choose ONE format, match what the screenshot shows):
 Format 1: PeriodN HH:MM-HH:MM
 Example: Period1 08:00-09:35
 Meaning: Period followed by period number (1, 2, 3...). Use this if the screenshot lists each period separately.
 Format 2: a-b HH:MM-HH:MM
 Example: 1-2 08:20-10:00
 Meaning: a-b means periods a through b share the same time slot. 1-2 means both period 1 and period 2 run 08:20-10:00.
 Single period shorthand: "5" is equivalent to "5-5" (period 5 alone).
 Use this if the screenshot groups multiple consecutive periods under one time.

Schedule line rules:
 · Period numbers must start from 1, in ascending order
 · Use ONLY one format throughout—do NOT mix Format 1 and Format 2 in the same schedule
 · No empty lines
 · One space between period and time
 · HH:MM is 24-hour format (HH: 00-23, MM: 00-59)
 · Do not prefix with "Schedule", "Periods", "时间表" or any other text

Omitting Schedule Block (Block B) rules—omit Block B entirely if ANY of these apply:
 · No start/end times visible in the screenshot
 · Different days have different schedules (cannot be expressed as one table)
 · You can see times but are uncertain about a specific period

========== Block C: Course Lines ==========

Each class session is ONE line, separated into EXACTLY 7 columns by Tab characters (NOT spaces, NOT commas). Column order and meaning are fixed:
 Column 1: Course name
 Column 2: Teacher
 Column 3: Room
 Column 4: Day of week
 Column 5: Period(s)
 Column 6: Week(s)
 Column 7: Type

Column rules:
 Column 1 Course name: Write exactly as shown in screenshot. Do not delete/add characters. Cannot contain Tab. If the same course has multiple time slots, write one line per slot.
 Column 2 Teacher: Write exactly as shown if present; if not shown, write "-" (hyphen). Never guess.
 Column 3 Room: Write exactly as shown if present; if not shown, write "-" (hyphen). Never guess.
 Column 4 Day of week: Write ONLY digits 1-7. Meaning: 1=Monday, 2=Tuesday, 3=Wednesday, 4=Thursday, 5=Friday, 6=Saturday, 7=Sunday. NEVER write "Monday", "周一", etc.
 Column 5 Period(s): Write the consecutive period range for this class. "1-2" means periods 1 and 2; "3" means only period 3; "3-5" means periods 3, 4, and 5. Must be a continuous range. Do NOT write non-consecutive like "1,3,5". If the screenshot shows non-consecutive periods (e.g., period 1 and 3 but period 2 is empty), write TWO separate course lines, each with its own time/week.
 Column 6 Week(s):
 · Consecutive weeks: Use a-b, e.g., 1-16 means weeks 1 through 16
 · Non-consecutive weeks: Use comma-separated items, e.g., 1,3,5 means weeks 1, 3, and 5; 1-8,10,12-16 means weeks 1-8 plus week 10 plus weeks 12-16
 · Must be digits 1-30; if exceeding 30 weeks, treat as anomalous and omit that course line
 Column 7 Type: Write ONLY digit 0, 1, or 2. Meaning: 0=every week; 1=odd weeks (1,3,5...); 2=even weeks (2,4,6...). If the screenshot says "单周/双周/每周", convert to the digit. NEVER write 3 or any other number.

Course line omission rules—omit the ENTIRE course line (do not output it) if ANY of these apply:
 · Column 4 (day) uncertain
 · Column 5 (periods) uncertain
 · Column 6 (weeks) uncertain
 · Column 7 (type) uncertain (except for the 0/1/2 mapping above)
 · Note: If Column 2 or Column 3 is missing, write "-" do NOT omit the line

Course lines must not contain empty lines. Do not insert empty lines between course lines.

========== Marker Line Rules ==========

All marker lines must be output exactly as: <<<SLEEPY-BEGIN>>>, <<<SLEEPY-TIME-BEGIN>>>, <<<SLEEPY-TIME-END>>>, <<<SLEEPY-END>>>. Do NOT wrap in backticks (do NOT write ```<<<SLEEPY-BEGIN>>>```) and do NOT change to square brackets like [SLEEPY-BEGIN].
Markers and content are separated by newlines. Markers must be literal—no extra spaces (no space between <<< and SLEEPY).

========== Complete Example (learn format only, do not copy content) ==========

<<<SLEEPY-BEGIN>>>
<<<SLEEPY-TIME-BEGIN>>>
Period1 08:00-09:35
Period2 09:55-11:30
Period3 13:30-15:05
<<<SLEEPY-TIME-END>>>
Calculus John A101 1 1-2 1-16 0
English Mary B202 1 3-4 1-16 1
PE - - 5 3 1-16 2
<<<SLEEPY-END>>>

resources.string: Content of a WakeUp-exported .json file, or JSON you write yourself in this structure.

string-array.name: format_wakeup_json_spec
string-array.item: The whole text must be JSON: starts with { and contains a courses array
Top level: name (table name), startDate (2026-09-07 format)
Each course: name, teacher, position (room), day (number 1-7, 1=Monday), startNode (first period), step (how many periods), startWeek/endWeek range, type (0 weekly / 1 odd / 2 even)
Periods 3-4 = startNode 3, step 2 (not 3 and 4)
color is optional

resources.string: Calendar files (.ics) exported from your school system or WakeUp. Pick the file via "Import from file", tap it in your file manager and choose Sleepy, or open it in a text editor and paste everything.

string-array.name: format_ics_spec
string-array.item: Text must start with BEGIN:VCALENDAR — dropping the first line breaks recognition
Each class is one event: SUMMARY = course name, LOCATION = room; teacher is read from the description
Weekday is derived from the event date; week 1 = the Monday of the earliest event\'s week
Periods are read from the "第X - Y节" line in the description, or estimated from start/end times
Biweekly events are merged automatically

resources.string: Registry-exported tables, or Excel files saved as "CSV (comma delimited)".

string-array.name: format_csv_spec
string-array.item: First line is the header. Required columns: course (course/name), day (day/weekday), node, week (week/weeks)
Optional columns: teacher, room, type, note
Node, two ways: one column like 1-2, or split into "start node" + "end node" columns
Day accepts 1-7, Monday, Mon
Week supports 1-16, 2-5,7-9, 11,13,15 — multiple ranges become separate courses
Optional "start time" + "end time" columns (HH:mm): real period times are applied automatically on import
Type accepts 0/1/2 or weekly/odd/even

resources.string: Timetable web pages saved as .html, copied table source, or tap the .html file in your file manager and choose Sleepy.

string-array.name: format_html_spec
string-array.item: Text must start with a tag like <!DOCTYPE, <html, or <table — any plain text before it breaks detection, delete it first
The page must contain a table whose header row includes "course"
Column names same as CSV: course, day, node, week required; teacher, room, type, note optional
Same as CSV: optional "start time" + "end time" columns, applied automatically on import
Grid layouts with Monday-Sunday columns cannot be parsed; needs a long table with one course per row

resources.string: The most flexible format: one line per class session. Good for typing by hand, even better for AI-generated text from screenshots (see the prompt below).

string-array.name: format_plain_spec
string-array.item: Column order is fixed: course, teacher, room, day, node, week, type (last column optional, defaults to weekly)
Columns separated by Tab, spaces, or full-width comma
Day accepts 1-7 or Monday-Sunday
Node: range like 1-2; single period like 3
Week: range like 1-16
Type accepts 0/1/2 or weekly/odd/even
Use - for missing teacher/room; lines starting with # are ignored
No spaces in course names, or the line is dropped
Period time lines (optional): Period N HH:mm-HH:mm, placed before course lines, applied automatically on import
AI chatter does not matter: wrap data between <<<SLEEPY-BEGIN>>> and <<<SLEEPY-END>>>, everything outside is ignored
